notes: Discovered candidates from /query-index.json (708-row EDS content index): a site-wide /us/c/new-introductions page plus five per-main-category 'new-introductions' pages that are URL children of each main category (ceiling/new-introductions, floor/new-introductions, outdoor/new-introductions, table/new-introductions, wall/new-introductions) rather than URL children of new-introductions itself - their combined qty (267+11+124+47+235=684) exceeds the site-wide page's own qty (353), confirming they are independent parallel listings, not a nested subset, so all are recorded as peer rows rather than a parent/children group. Verified every candidate's exact qty via the public GraphQL query products(filter:{category_url_path:{eq:"<path>"}}){total_count}. Candidates that the content index listed but which do NOT exist as live categories (confirmed via categories(filters:{url_path:{eq:"<path>"}}){items{...}} returning an empty items[] - i.e. orphaned/retired EDS entries) were dropped: new-introductions/trade-exclusive, fans/new-introductions, fans/new-fan-introductions, shop/new-and-ready-to-ship, shop/new-and-ready-to-ship-2, shop/new-and-ready-to-ship-generation-lighting, shop/new-and-ready-to-ship-modern-collection, shop/new-and-ready-to-ship-signature, shop/new-arrivals-amber-lewis, shop/new-introductions-lamps, shop/new-year-new-arrivals. Two further candidates DO exist as live categories with real qty - shop/new-and-in-stock (142) and shop/modern-new-and-in-stock (113) - but their title/URL conflate 'new' with 'in stock' (availability/readiness-to-ship), which is a different concept from recency; the EDS SPA body is client-rendered so only SSR title/meta could be checked without escalating to Playwright/CDP, so both are recorded but flagged ambiguous per the brief's Collection-page guidance rather than guessed either way. No login/trade gate encountered on any of this catalog data.
